text.p: Harsco Corp said Wednesday its Heckett MultiServ division won a 15-year $175 million contract to service a new steel mill under construction in Thailand.

Harsco said the contract with Thailand's private SSP Group's Siam Strip Mill Public Co Ltd calls for on-site services at new thin-slab technology mill in Rayong, the largest minimill project under construction in Thailand.

A joint venture 70 percent owned by Heckett Multiserv will provide services such as raw material and scrap management, slag processing, metal recovery, and handling of finished steel coils, Harsco said.
The company said the mill is scheduled to start production in the second half of 1998, with output expected to reach more than 1.5 million tons per year.
Harsco's stock hit a 52-week high of 43-1/2 Wednesday, but traded unchanged at 43-1/4 at around noon.
